curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach the brake and turn light requirement, how those lights may be mounted, keeping lights clean, and setting mirrors.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per rule; a contrast card for the light distance and mounting.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on light and mirror requirements.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover what brakes must do, two ways to apply them, pedal height and warning signs, anti-lock brakes and how to use them, and theft prevention.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each rule; a contrast card for ABS versus pumping.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on brake checks and ABS use.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach when a tire is legally unsafe, under versus over inflation, and monthly pressure checks.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each rule; contrast cards for inflation and the equipment limits.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on tire condition and pressure.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover emergency lights and sirens, horn requirements and use, mufflers and exhaust leaks, suspension warning signs, and hazard flashers.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each device; contrast cards for the horn limits and flashers versus emergency lights.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on which equipment is required or allowed.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Show the fuel cost of speed and hard starts, engine-off and window habits, and filters and fuel caps.
Teach looking ahead, checking mirrors, when to check behind and blind spots, and easing forward when the view is blocked.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each habit; contrast cards for look-ahead versus mirror timing and mirrors versus blind spots.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain when to signal, signal lights and sun glare, signaling distances, and the three hand signals.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each rule and hand signal; contrast cards for the distances and hand positions.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on signal distances and hand signals.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover tailgaters and lane position, then choosing between two dangers.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per rule; a contrast card for unequal versus equal dangers.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on handling two hazards.
